subject: Foray #2 — the types of capital and funding available to startups
purpose: Prioritised ASR work order. Every row is an episode we want a timed transcript for and cannot get one for free. Sorted by value per minute of CPU: an episode that opens an EMPTY arc slot outranks one that adds depth to a filled one.
companions: docs/curation/foray2-capital-sourcing.md — the shortlist, the measurements, and the arc slots that could NOT be sourced
docs/adr/0008-ad-tolerance-and-timestamp-precision.md — the ad rule applied here (delta in seconds, N>=2, pad = delta_max + margin)
docs/curation/grilling-asr-manifest.json — the shape this file follows
committed_here_because: docs/curation/ carries no source prose — only feed metadata we measured ourselves — and data-local/ is gitignored, so a manifest placed there would be invisible to every other checkout and to cloud runners. Same call as grilling-asr-manifest.json.

method.ad_delta: Per ADR-0008: delta in SECONDS, not a ratio. delta_sec = itunes:duration * (delivered_bytes / declared_bytes - 1), where delivered_bytes is the true total read from Content-Range on a 2-byte ranged GET (tools/transcribe/ad-inflation.mjs). HEAD lies on ad-inserting hosts and was not used.
method.probe_note: N=2 on the SAME episode is mandatory (ADR-0008 Decision 2). Every episode in this file returned BYTE-IDENTICAL totals on both probes, i.e. observed spread 0.0 s. That is weaker than it looks: Gastropod's two probes differed by 33.4 s, so a zero spread means we did not observe variance, not that there is none.
method.pad: pad = delta_max + margin. Where the delta is non-zero, the pad applies ADR-0008 s stated and explicitly UNMEASURED assumption that the margin scales with the delta at Gastropod s 0.505 coefficient, i.e. pad ~= 1.505 * delta_max. Admit if pad <= 120 s. WHERE THE DELTA IS 0.0 s THE PAD IS QUOTED AS 0.0 s, WHICH CARRIES NO MARGIN AND IS THEREFORE A POINT ESTIMATE — the exact statistic ADR-0008 forbids. Those rows are DAI-capable hosts (Libsyn, transistor, Buzzsprout) that simply were not injecting on the episodes and days we sampled. A non-zero nominal margin may be required before any of them plays; ADR-0008 open question 3 is where that gets decided and nothing here settles it.
method.duration_source: itunes:duration from the feed on every row; there is no row whose true duration could not be obtained.
method.duration_caveat: itunes:duration is feed metadata and this repo has measured it wrong by 244 s on a show with no ads at all (Radiolab, tools/transcribe/README.md). Treat the audio_seconds totals below as +/- a few percent, and measure from the file when transcribing.
method.ratio_omitted: Per-row ad_free_ratio is deliberately omitted. ADR-0008 Decision 2 keeps the ratio as a cheap screen, and it stays derivable: every row carries declared_bytes and delivered_bytes, so ratio = delivered/declared. Seconds are recorded because seconds are what the tolerance is in. The one row where no ratio exists (NIH) says so and explains why.

language_gate: English only, per the standing founder ruling. Every row is English audio; no non-English candidate is listed and none is held in reserve.

read_this_before_spending_cpu.the_free_inventory_comes_first: 30 episodes totalling 6.16 h already ship timed transcripts and are NOT in this file: VC Minute x24 (VTT+SRT+JSON, 60-290 s, 24/24 probed at ratio 1.0000), Run the Numbers x2 (SRT), The Bootstrapped Founder x3 (VTT), Startup Therapy x1 (SRT). READ THE NEXT KEY BEFORE BUDGETING AGAINST THAT 6.16 h — most of it is VC Minute and the relative cap restricts what VC Minute can supply.
read_this_before_spending_cpu.priority_1_is_the_whole_job: Priority 1 is 9 episodes / 6.37 h / 5.79 CPU-hours at 1.1x. It opens the THREE slots the free inventory cannot reach at all (A5 accelerators, A11 equity crowdfunding, A12 corporate VC), upgrades A1, A3 and A9 from free rows the relative cap limits to 27-30 s — below the segment floor for A1 and A3 — to an actual explanation, and carries the primary grants row. Priority 1 plus the 5.02 h of uncapped free inventory is 11.4 h of tape against the ~8 h a 1-hour Foray needs at 12% yield. Priorities 2 and 3 exist so the ordering can be cut, not because all 35 rows should run.
read_this_before_spending_cpu.two_content_risks_worth_five_minutes_eac: (1) The Startup Solution is 10 rows and 2.48 h of this manifest across five arc slots, and threshold.vc returns HTTP 403 to our fetcher, so the content gate was passed on show notes rather than on a transcript. A3 is the one slot resting on it alone. (2) Feel the Boot 89 is the primary SBIR row, is a vendor-adjacent interview (the guest sells an SBIR application platform), and the show publishes to YouTube, so audio-only sufficiency is UNVERIFIED. Note that is a NEW risk axis for this project, not a precedent: grilling-foray-batch-1.md records that nothing has failed the audio-only gate, and the four content rejections on file were for suspected machine generation, SEO filler, an affiliate-plugging host segment with no guest, and two hosts reminiscing. Listen before transcribing either.
read_this_before_spending_cpu.timings_only_candidates: Two rows in this file have untimed publisher prose that a force-alignment mode would turn into timings at a fraction of full ASR: guid Buzzsprout-19562341 (Raw Selection, secondaries) and guid Buzzsprout-19451873 (Raw Selection, founder-led software) — both Buzzsprout text/html. Note the .vtt sibling 404s WITH a 2,877-byte body, so do not test transcript availability by response size. Outside this file, the 33 plain-text Startup Therapy transcripts are the same case. Same trick as the Moreish Podcast row in grilling-asr-manifest.json.
read_this_before_spending_cpu.unfillable_slots: Scoped to what this pass could see — Apple search plus ~25 feeds, item counts recorded per negative in foray2-capital-sourcing.md §5. On that surface: A6b (growth-stage VC) and A11b (rewards crowdfunding as a form of capital, rather than as a marketing campaign) have no source at any transcription budget, and ordinary bank credit for a startup that is not being acquired is likewise unsourced — A9 is filled only for SBA acquisition lending. These are conclusions about the surface searched, not about podcasting; the PodcastIndex bulk dump would test them cheaply and was NOT queried for this subject.
read_this_before_spending_cpu.one_show_died: NCI SBIR Innovation Lab would have owned A10 with 16 free agency-published SRTs. Every enclosure TESTED returns HTTP 404 — 3 of its 26 episodes (12, 14, 18), each across 3 URL shapes and 2 user agents, against a same-host Libsyn control that returned 206 in the same minute. Its transcripts still fetch 200 and read cleanly, so every cheap check passes and a transcript-availability screen would have admitted it. Do not re-add it without fetching an enclosure first.
read_this_before_spending_cpu.the_relative_cap_reshapes_the_free_inven: segment-length-rules.md §0 caps a segment at <= 20% of its source episode s duration. Applied to the 24 VC Minute rows: 10 of 24 have a 20% cap BELOW the 30 s hard floor and can yield no compliant segment at all; the other 14 cap out between 30 s and 51 s, clearing the quote role s 30 s floor (four only just) and never reaching the 75-180 s target band. D4 then caps quotes at <= 20% of segments, at most 2 adjacent, so a 35-segment Foray admits <= 7 of them — roughly 5 minutes of the hour. THE FREE INVENTORY WHERE THE CAP IS NOT BINDING IS SIX EPISODES AND 5.02 h: Run the Numbers x2, Bootstrapped Founder x3, Startup Therapy x1. Consequence, and it runs the opposite way to intuition: this makes THIS FILE more load-bearing, not less. If the founders want more from VC Minute, that is a request to revisit the 20% cap for sources under ~10 minutes — ask it as that, do not assume it.

totals.cost_note: 1.1x realtime is the figure supplied with this work order and assumes an otherwise idle machine; CPU hours are audio hours DIVIDED by the rate, same convention as grilling-asr-manifest.json. tools/transcribe measured 1.33x for base.en (transcription-scale-plan.md §1) and the live whisper queue has run at 0.475x under contention. At 0.475x the full 18.95 h is 39.9 CPU-hours — about two days of laptop, and not a thing to start. Priority 1 alone is 5.79 CPU-hours at 1.1x / 13.4 h at 0.475x, and that is the number to budget against.

slots_no_amount_of_asr_can_fill.evidence: No episode found that explains what a Series B/C or growth-equity round buys, how growth investors underwrite differently, or what changes in the terms. Zero title matches for growth equity / growth stage / continuation fund / GP-led across Capital Allocators (815 items); nothing usable in The Full Ratchet (1,022), Raw Selection (224), VC Minute (275) or Swimming with Allocators (108). What exists is Series A content and LP-facing growth-equity talk. See foray2-capital-sourcing.md §5.2.

Crowdfunding Demystified's 99 episodes are campaign marketing case studies ('How this New Inventor Launched a $188,763 Kickstarter'). Nothing found explains rewards crowdfunding AS FINANCING: pre-selling as working capital, the fulfilment liability it creates, its cost against a loan, why hardware uses it and software does not. The equity half of A11 is genuinely sourced; this half is a narrator case. See §5.4.

Every SBA source found — 484 Acquiring Minds episodes, ThinkSBA — is 7(a) lending to BUY AN EXISTING BUSINESS.
